verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.speechischeap.com/mcp that uses Streamable HTTP and OAuth sign-in with the user's API key. The docs list tools (cancel_job, prepare_upload, check_access) and transcribe/subtitles prompt templates, and llms.txt references the server. A runtime probe confirmed the endpoint is live and correctly OAuth-gated with published protected-resource metadata. Missing for 10: independent user or hands-on reports of a full transcription session through an agent client, and an explicitly quoted job-creation/transcription tool in the excerpted tool list.
